description: This Java class, `ComponentLoaderConfig`, handles the manipulation and parsing of component loader XML files (`component-load.xml`) used within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods to locate root components, parse configuration files, and define component descriptors, supporting dynamic component management in the system.

classes.name: ComponentLoaderConfig
classes.description: Main class providing static methods to load and parse component configuration XML files and to retrieve component definitions.

classes.name: ComponentLoaderConfig.ComponentDef
classes.description: Represents a component or component directory configuration with location and type, with factory method to instantiate from XML.

classes.name: ComponentLoaderConfig.ComponentType
classes.description: Enumeration for differentiating between a single component and a component directory.

methods.name: getRootComponents
methods.description: Retrieves the list of root component definitions from the classpath's default `component-load.xml`.

methods.name: getComponentsFromConfig
methods.description: Parses a given `component-load.xml` file URL and extracts component definitions.

methods.name: ComponentDef.of
methods.description: Static factory method creating a ComponentDef instance from an XML element.

methods.name: parseDocumentFromUrl
methods.description: Reads and parses an XML document from a URL with error handling.
